verses.1: Son, if you have hurt your enemy, then you have done a terrible thing to him.
verses.2: You were captured by the words of your mouth; you were trapped in the words of your own lips.
verses.3: Do this, my son. Then you will be saved, for you have come with your enemy’s help. You will be able to defeat him and overcome his schemes.
verses.4: Do not give your eyes any rest, and do not let your eyelids sleep.
verses.5: It is rescued as if by a hand, and as if by magic.
verses.6: Go to the port. Slowly, see its paths and be wise.
verses.7: Because she has no officer to manage and supervise her.
verses.8: You must prepare the honey in the hives before harvesting it for food.
verses.9: Until death, I will remain asleep; until death, I will not rise from my sleep.
verses.10: A little sleep, a little rest, and a little time to rest one’s hands.
verses.11: And may your head and your arms be strong, like those of a warrior.
verses.12: A man without any friends, who walks alone and alone.
verses.13: He sees with his eyes, walks with his feet, and moves along the surfaces of things.
verses.14: They are constantly filled with thoughts of evil, at all times. They send out evil spirits.
verses.15: So, suddenly, Eido will come. Suddenly, it will be completed, and there will be no more delay.
verses.16: May the Lord be pleased, and may his soul be free from seven kinds of suffering.
verses.17: My eyes are blind to falsehoods, and my hands shed blood.
verses.18: The heart that is filled with thoughts of evil, and the feet that hurry to do evil.
verses.19: He will spread falsehoods as if they were truths, and he will also cause brothers to be divided against each other.
verses.20: I obey the commandment of my father; do not follow the laws of your mother.
verses.21: They remain attached to your heart, always hanging around on your shoulders.
verses.22: As you go through life, she will take care of you and protect you. And those who come after you will also take care of you.
verses.23: For the lamp of commandment and law is light and a path to life.
verses.24: To protect you from the evil woman, from being separated from your true lover.
verses.25: Do not delight in her beauty in your heart, and do not take her into your eyes.
verses.26: For with this woman, one can find bread to eat; and the wife of a man is a precious treasure indeed.
verses.27: One man shall be burned to death, but his clothes and hair shall not be burned.
verses.28: If a man were to walk on the rough ground, and his feet would not get hurt.
verses.29: Thus, when a man’s wife becomes pregnant, none of those who touch her shall be punished.
verses.30: They will not be captured by the thief, for he will steal to fill his soul with evil.
verses.31: And it was found that Yeshalem paid for all the repairs in his house.
verses.32: He despises a heartless woman; she corrupts his soul. He will do her harm.
verses.33: He who touches and kills will find his own destruction; his shame will never be erased.
verses.34: For jealousy is a fierce and cruel spirit; it does not show kindness on the day of punishment.
verses.35: No one shall lift their face; no one shall eat, for the time of famine will come soon.
